name: Zenify
description: Open-source music streaming app with synced multilingual lyrics, a glassmorphic UI and a native Flutter mobile app. Built with Next.js, Fastify and Prisma.

paragraphs: Zenify is an open-source web music player and ad-free Spotify alternative created for music lovers who appreciate clean visuals, instant playback, and native synchronized lyrics for Indian and global regional languages.

Commercial music apps often treat non-English lyrics as an afterthought—showing unsynced blocks of text or missing romanized words entirely. Zenify features a custom karaoke-grade lyric alignment engine, a hardware-accelerated Studio Audio DSP Suite (3-band EQ, 8D spatial sound, nightcore/slowed modes), an in-browser local audio player, and a dynamic liquid glass UI that flows with your album's colors.
🎧 Start listening immediately in your browser: Visit listenzenify.vercel.app — no account or download required!
features: 🎤 Sub-Second Synced Lyrics: Real-time karaoke alignment for Tamil, Tanglish, Hindi, Malayalam, and English with smart protection during instrumental guitar and violin solos ([BGM], [Interlude]).
3-Band Equalizer: Fine-tune Bass, Mid, and Treble with instant Bass Boost and Vocal Booster presets.
8D Spatial Audio: Immersive sound that dynamically orbits around your headphones.
DJ Playback Modes: One-click Nightcore (1.5x speed) and Daycore / Slowed (0.75x speed + reverb).
